entries.title: Atrius India bronze Patient
entries.description: One row per Patient. Join key is patient_id. MRN uses the HIS identifier system.
entries.runHint: PUT ViewDefinition/atrius-in-patient on clinical HFS, then POST /$sql-run or $viewdefinition-run. This endpoint never executes the view.

entries.title: Atrius India bronze Encounter
entries.description: One row per Encounter. class_code is AMB/IMP/EMER for HMIS-style aggregates.
entries.runHint: PUT ViewDefinition/atrius-in-encounter on clinical HFS, then POST /$sql-run. This endpoint never executes the view.

entries.title: Atrius India bronze Observation
entries.description: One row per Observation. Quantity, string, and codeable values are separate columns. Join on patient_id / encounter_id.
entries.runHint: PUT ViewDefinition/atrius-in-observation on clinical HFS, then POST /$sql-run. This endpoint never executes the view.

entries.title: Atrius India bronze Condition
entries.description: One row per Condition with ICD-10, ICD-11 MMS, and SNOMED columns plus the IDSP reportable flag.
entries.runHint: PUT ViewDefinition/atrius-in-condition on clinical HFS, then POST /$sql-run. This endpoint never executes the view.

entries.title: Atrius India bronze MedicationRequest
entries.description: One row per MedicationRequest. medication[x] is split into CodeableConcept columns and a Reference key.
entries.runHint: PUT ViewDefinition/atrius-in-medicationrequest on clinical HFS, then POST /$sql-run. This endpoint never executes the view.

entries.title: Atrius India bronze Claim
entries.description: One row per Claim header. Line items are a separate view so this grain stays one row per claim.
entries.runHint: PUT ViewDefinition/atrius-in-claim on clinical HFS, then POST /$sql-run. This endpoint never executes the view.

entries.title: Atrius India bronze Claim item
entries.description: One row per Claim.item (forEach). Join to the claim header on claim_id.
entries.runHint: PUT ViewDefinition/atrius-in-claim-item on clinical HFS, then POST /$sql-run. This endpoint never executes the view.

entries.title: Patient + latest Observation of a given code
entries.description: One row per Patient with that patient's most recent Observation matching :code / :code_system (defaults: LOINC 4548-4 HbA1c).
entries.runHint: PUT the bronze views and this SQLQuery Library, then POST /$sql-run with subjectCanonical set to this Library URL. This endpoint never runs the SELECT.

entries.title: Encounter + diagnoses + charge totals
entries.description: One row per Encounter-Condition pair with grouped charge_net / charge_lines so diagnoses and claim lines do not cartesian-expand.
entries.runHint: PUT the bronze views and this SQLQuery Library, then POST /$sql-run with subjectCanonical set to this Library URL. This endpoint never runs the SELECT.

entries.title: Claim header + line items
entries.description: One row per Claim.item, with header status, type, and total repeated.
entries.runHint: PUT the bronze views and this SQLQuery Library, then POST /$sql-run with subjectCanonical set to this Library URL. This endpoint never runs the SELECT.
